attributes.name: value_of
attributes.purpose: The model value of one HCL expression as hcl() writes it: a quoted string without interpolation -> str (\\ and \" unescaped); true/false -> bool; numbers -> int/float; a one-line [..] -> tuple of values (except a for expression, [for ...], which is one expression); a multi-line {..} -> dict of 'key = value' lines (keys as written); anything else (a reference, function call, conditional, quoted ${} template, multi-line jsonencode, a for expression [for ...] or one-line {for ...}) -> '${<text>}', the raw form block()/hcl() take, so it writes back unchanged. Pure.

attributes.description: Milestone 99 items 8-11 (brief: decision note on milestone 99; deferred notes 2988, 2989, 2990). (10) opsdir-adapter-kubernetes tests/test_kubernetes_gateway.py:187: mark the validate-kubernetes.sh test kubernetes (as the other tool tests are marked) so the default suite doesn't run it. (11) opsdir-base-ds tests/test_ds_collect.py: empty: delete it or give it the shared collector tests that belong there (check test_pingds_collect.py / test_opendj_collect.py for duplication first). Packages: opsdir-format-arm, opsdir-format-terraform, opsdir-adapter-kubernetes (tests), opsdir-base-ds (tests); their READMEs' Known limits.
